title: Love Live! Hasu no Sora Jōgakuin School Idol Club TV Anime Unveils 7-Episode Run, January 10 Debut

title: The Simpsons Officially Brings Back Apu After 9 Years With New Voice Actor Revealed
content: The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu to the animated series with a new voice actor after being missing in action for nearly a decade. The Simpsons Season 38 is now underway with new episodes airing this Fall, and with it fans have been treated to a second Treehouse of Horror Presents episode .
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Spooky Anime You Should Watch on Netflix This October
content: In the past few years, Netflix has emerged as a major anime streaming platform, and it wouldn’t be far-fetched to call it the second-largest. It has achieved this by offering many of the same anime available on Crunchyroll, with fans increasingly turning to Netflix as their main source for anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Boruto’s New Preview Hints at the New Hokage’s Replacement as Naruto Prepares to Return
content: The new sneak peek for Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 hints that Shikamaru’s position as Hokage is being challenged. The chapter is only a couple of days away as of this writing, and as the series usually does before a release, it has unveiled a sneak peek.
author: ComicBook

title: 7 Anime to Watch If You Were Disappointed With One-Punch Man Season 3
content: Season 1 of One-Punch Man remains as one of the most iconic action anime adaptations to date. Even today, the first season is remembered fondly by fans. When Season 2 released it represented a turning point for many fans of both the anime and the manga.
